name: Candesartan
mechanism: Selective antagonist of angiotensin II at AT1 receptors
dosing: Hypertension: Start 8mg daily, usual 8-16mg daily, max 32mg daily. Heart failure: Start 4mg daily
contraindications: Pregnancy, bilateral renal artery stenosis, severe renal/hepatic impairment
interactions: NSAIDs (↓ efficacy), potassium supplements (hyperkalemia), lithium (↑ levels)
monitoring: eGFR, potassium, blood pressure. Check 1-2 weeks after starting
sideEffects: Dizziness, hyperkalemia, acute kidney injury, angioedema (rare)
pharmacokinetics: Prodrug, active metabolite half-life: 9h, renal and biliary excretion
clinicalPearls: Alternative to ACE inhibitor if cough. Often better tolerated than other ARBs
indication: Hypertension, heart failure, diabetic nephropathy, post-MI
